cwb-baidu-1.webp.zh: 巴西空军（Força Aérea Brasileira）的波音 737 从库里蒂巴的跑道上腾空而起。
cwb-baidu-1.webp.en: A Brazilian Air Force Boeing 737 climbing away from Curitiba's runway.

cwb-baidu-2.webp.zh: 滑行道上的图-154 客机：三发客机正对镜头滑行——这类罕见机型正是航空摄影者蹲守库里蒂巴的理由。
cwb-baidu-2.webp.en: A Tu-154 taxiing head-on, its three engines in view — the kind of rare visitor that draws spotters to Curitiba.
